decision: Freeze the promotion path for future fresh web roots so the next standalone and harness runs consume the same admitted source-backed web bundles without leakage, prompt drift, or scoring drift.

bridge_contract.unit_of_independence: root bundle, not individual perspective row
promotion_order: run root-level leakage scan against current live eval frontier
compile admitted bundles into standalone prompt rows
mirror the same admitted bundles into harness payload rows
compare 100M and Gemma on the same admitted root set
shared_invariants: Same root bundle identity must be preserved across standalone and harness payloads.
Candidate semantics may be reformatted for execution, but gold answer meaning cannot change.
If a root is abstention-only under standalone review, it remains abstention-only in harness scoring.
Do not mix exhausted reviewed web roots with fresh web roots in a way that hides source overlap.

standalone_flow.training_use_rule: Fresh admitted web roots may support the standalone 100M frontier only if they remain outside the current live heldout/miss set.

harness_flow.promotion_rule: Only admitted fresh web roots with stable prompt/writeback mapping enter the locked task pack.
harness_flow.comparison_rule: 100M and Gemma must execute the same task-pack rows with the same root identities and evaluator semantics.

anti_cheat_guards: Run candidate-order permutation or equivalent position-invariance checks before claiming a web improvement.
Track whether selected_tests are absent; zero-test web roots require heightened abstention scrutiny.
Reject any bridge step that converts a current eval miss root into train support.
Preserve source provenance fields so future source-heldout claims remain auditable.
next_best_step: Use this bridge only after fresh web roots are generated under Stage10259; do not run another multilingual bounded replay until at least one admitted fresh web bundle exists.
